n06315c1e95.headline: The biggest increase in salaries and pensions so far
n06315c1e95.summary: Serbian Prime Minister Aleksandar Vučić announced the biggest increase in salaries and pensions so far, with plans for even larger hikes next year.
n06315c1e95.why: Wage and pension increases impact consumer spending, inflation, and fiscal policy in Serbia's economy.
